Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020174249/https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/blob/d4e661ec/Light.json Internet Archive]</ref>
* The [[Undercover]] character prevents the opponent from Force draining at same site, and allows the owner to deploy to same site even without presence or Force icons. These benefits are the same even if the [[Undercover]] character is a droid.
* The [[Undercover]] character is inactive (for example it does not participate in battles) but outside of battle it may be targeted by Interrupts and anything that could make it dueled, hit, or lost.
* The owner may voluntarily break cover during their deploy phase.
* If the character's cover is broken (either voluntarily or by another card such as [[Lt. Pol Treidum]]), then [[Undercover]] is lost.

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:ANH-L-undercover-PC-Errata-2013-slip-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with the printed card [[Undercover]] (Decipher; Decipher's [[Undercover (Decipher Errata 1998)|November 1998 errata]] was published as text only): The game text changes: “If at a site during” becomes “During”; “Effect).” becomes “Effect) if at a site. (Immune to Alter.)”. These are the same words as [[Undercover (Decipher Errata 1998)|Decipher's errata]]. The slip adds a black strip below the text box with the title “Undercover” and a white italic “E”.

Lower part of the printed card (the area the slip covers, scaled to the slip's width) and the slip as cut from the sheet at 300 dpi; nothing else is edited.
